استنظرا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْظَرَا (istanẓarā) /is.tan.ðˤa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَنْظَرَ (istanẓara)
# اُسْتُنْظِرَا (ustunẓirā) /us.tun.ðˤi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَنْظَرَ (istanẓara)
# اِسْتَنْظِرَا (istanẓirā) /is.tan.ðˤi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَنْظَرَ (istanẓara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
